question: Which TV star just filed for divorce at the worst possible time?
story: The Bear star Abby Elliott just filed for divorce two months before her tenth wedding anniversary. If you watch the show, you know her as Natalie, the sister who is always stressed in the kitchen. Turns out real life had its own drama. According to TMZ, Elliott filed on July seventeenth to end her marriage to producer Bill Kennedy, citing the classic irreconcilable differences. Here is the timeline that stings. Reports say the two actually separated on July eighth, just weeks before the anniversary of the day they married back in 2016. They reportedly met on the set of one of his films, got engaged, and share two young kids, ages five and three. Elliott is said to be asking for joint custody of both. Their last red carpet together was reportedly only this past March. Sometimes the biggest plot twist is not on the show.
